an3.98:1.1: aṅganteva saṅkhayaṁ → aṅgantveva saṅkhaṁ (bj); aṅgantveva saṁkhaṁ (sya-all) | bhadro assājānīyo → bhaddo assājāniyo (sya-all)
an3.98:1.4: aṅganteva saṅkhyaṁ → aṅganttheva saṅkhaṁ (bj); aṅgantveva saṁkhaṁ (sya-all) | tīhi aṅgehi → tīhaṅgehi (sya-all) | bhadro assājānīyo → bhaddo assājāniyo (sya-all)
